verdict.rationale: Svelte ships `sv check` for surfacing type errors from the command line and an official MCP server that gives agents documentation plus static analysis of generated code to 'write better Svelte code', which could help an AI tool catch and fix type issues. However, there is no direct evidence of an automated type-error-resolution workflow (e.g., agent auto-patching code based on `sv check` output) — missing for 10: explicit documentation or demonstration of automatic fixing/resolution of type errors, independent/hands-on confirmation that AI tooling actually resolves such errors end-to-end.
